verdict.rationale: Deel's individuals page promises "transparent, upfront pricing—no hidden legal fees" and a 100% fee refund on USCIS denial. However, the evidence shows no actual published fee amounts or priced service menu; cost figures appear to arrive only as a personalized breakdown within 48 hours of submitting an eligibility check. Missing for 10: actual published flat-fee figures, a priced service menu on Deel's site, and prices visible without submitting an eligibility request.
